channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Damian Lillard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Damian Lillard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Haliburton said he missed a chance to meet with Lillard, who returned to the Trail Blazers in the 2025 offseason after being waived by the Bucks, when he didn't go to Portland following a case of shingles.

“I would love to have a conversation [with Lillard] because I just think it became more than it ever needed to be,”

Tyrese Haliburton on Damian Lillard, Oct 9, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Tiago Splitter on Damian Lillard’s return:

“He’s a great guy. You love the way he works, his personality, humble. Going through an injury like he was, just seeing him hooping again and having fun and knocking down 3s, you gotta smile for that and feel good for him.”

Tiago Splitter on Damian Lillard, Oct 8, 2026. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard
item.description:
Jusuf Nurkic:

“We had that great mindset, starting with Damian Lillard, who was a real leader. He led by example. I don’t know how to explain it in the best way, but whatever he wanted others to do, that’s how it was. He could be loud, but he always led by example, whether in practice or on the plane — the guy was never late. We never had any problems in the locker room. Whoever came in through trades had to fit into that system. Until Carmelo (laughs). He kind of stepped outside the system because he was always late, he missed almost every meeting. The coach was traumatized by that and didn’t want anyone to be late, and he didn’t have many rules, but he stuck to that one.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, Jun 1, 2026. Source: Basketball Sphere.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Deni Avdija on playing next to Damian Lillard next year:

“Me and Dame had conversations throughout the year. He has a lot of things we need. We both have mutual goals and we love each other's games. I think we can do great things together, for sure.”

Deni Avdija on Damian Lillard, Apr 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Aaron Goodwin on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Damian Lillard's agent Aaron Goodwin on his client leaving Milwaukee and his future:

“It’s an incredible opportunity for Damian. He receives all of his money guaranteed, and it provides him an opportunity to decide his next destination as an unrestricted free agent. He gets a chance to rehab at home if he chooses to, and be with his family and his kids for the next year. The goal is for him to take his time and make a decision on what his next destination will be.”

Aaron Goodwin on Damian Lillard, Jul 1, 2025. Source: Twitter @AaronJFentress.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on Damian Lillard, Draymond Green
item.description:
“It started with KD, Draymond [Green], all the way down, Dame [Damian Lillard]. He had appropriate fear all along because he knew we weren't invincible.”

Lloyd Pierce on Damian Lillard, Draymond Green, May 2, 2025. Source: FoxSports.com.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Damian Lillard
item.description:
NBA analyst and former teammate of Antetokounmpo, Demarcus Cousins believes that there is a possibility that Giannis Antetokounmpo could leave the team for a bigger market team if things don't work out.

“As his teammate I learned there's always truth in his humor. And he's a lot smarter than he likes to give. I could see that happening. Especially, if the experiment with Damian Lillard doesn't go as planned. It's obvious he was ready to move from Milwaukee once before. If this thing don't work out, I could absolutely see him in Chicago. It's right down the street, he's comfortable in the Midwest. And obviously Chicago is a great market for any superstar,”

DeMarcus Cousins on Damian Lillard, Feb 6, 2025. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Norman Powell on DeMar DeRozan, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Powell said Wednesday night.

“Learning from when I was in Toronto with Kyle and DeMar (DeRozan), learning from Dame (Lillard) and CJ (McCollum), learning from PG and Kawhi. Being around those top guys and just getting game and knowledge from them in the summer. Going up against them, battling, and just wanting that.”

Norman Powell on DeMar DeRozan, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Nov 8, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Keon Ellis on Stephen Curry, Damian Lillard, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“A guy like [Jalen] Brunson or [Steph] Curry, [Damian Lillard], you have to be in their airspace because any little bit of room, it's going up, and we know how those guys can get it going,”

Keon Ellis on Stephen Curry, Damian Lillard, Jalen Brunson, Sep 5, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
“Melo [Anthony] was actually still on theroster. I really took the job thinking that I was going to be coaching him. You know with Dame [Lillard] and CJ [McCollum], Nurk [Nurkic]. So it was perfect for me, I'm thinking okay boom, a few moves here and there, I'm coming to like try to elevate things and then very quickly it changed.”

Chauncey Billups on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, Jul 23, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Damian Lillard, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Josh Hart
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“We gotta do much better containing Hart in transition. When he gets a defensive rebound, he’s great at just taking it and knifing his way full court to the basket. He’s a guy we gotta treat like Giannis [Antetokounmpo] and [Damian] Lillard and guys like that that are full court, high speed attackers. He really had a high impact on the game yesterday.”

Rick Carlisle on Damian Lillard, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Josh Hart, May 8, 2024. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Damian Lillard, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on the potential returns of Giannis Antetokounmpo and Damian Lillard:

“I don't know how to answer that. I know I hope. I think they're very, very, very close.”

Doc Rivers on Damian Lillard, Giannis Antetokounmpo, May 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Doc Rivers says Lillard worked out yesterday and will again today Rivers on if Lillard may play Fri:

“He’s closer. If it’s not 100% then no. We’re just not going to take a chance”

Doc Rivers on Damian Lillard, Apr 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @JamalCollier.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kyrie Irving, Damian Lillard
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I saw Damian Lillard tweet Kyrie Irving is the most skilled player in NBA history' and quite frankly I'm not sure who can argue against that.”

Draymond Green on Kyrie Irving, Damian Lillard, Mar 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adrian Griffin on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Eric Nehm:Adrian Griffin, on Lillard:

“He's a rhythm player. He had his legs under him. He got to the free throw line and that was incredible.”

Adrian Griffin on Damian Lillard, Oct 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Damian Lillard
item.description:
“You saw the Damian Lillard trade talks all summer, and I never saw Milwaukee in that conversation. I never heard about them [being interested]. So, opening up my phone and seeing that definitely shocked me.”

Jayson Tatum on Damian Lillard, Oct 5, 2023. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Joe Cronin:

“I want to open up thanking Damian Lillard for 11 incredible seasons with us. Obviously a Blazers legend. We're excited to see what he has in store next and we're rooting for him.”

Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“He texts me about an hour ago, and I asked him, ‘Are you happy?’ [Damian Lillard] wrote:“I am, you know, I think it will finally come to light that I'm one of those guys at the very top. They have discredited me for years without acknowledgement how I was never even close to even playing field with everybody else…”

Gilbert Arenas on Damian Lillard, Sep 29, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jon Horst on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Milwaukee Bucks GM Jon Horst on Damian Lillard:

“An elite player in our league and someone we’ve long been fans of. These opportunities are rare and hard to measure and execute.”

Jon Horst on Damian Lillard, Sep 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Nikola Jovic on Damian Lillard trade rumors and his future:

“It's basketball. Of course I'd love to be in Miami. Those guys are great and they helped me a lot. What happens, happens. I hope I stay there. That's all”

Nikola Jovic on Damian Lillard, Aug 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Tracy McGrady on Damian Lillard’s trade request to Miami:

“Dame has done his job of doing everything he possibly can to win a championship in Portland, he's giving them everything and I think Dame, his agent, they’re just looking at it like they don't have too many great years left in that body so he wants to win a championship and he wants to be a really huge part of why he wins the championship, and that's with a particular team and he sees that in Miami. I have no issue with that. The man has really done everything he possibly can so to reward him and be rewarded is to go with the team that he feels his best chance of winning the championship. I have no problem.”

Tracy McGrady on Damian Lillard, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Celtics Wire.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Blazers GM Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard's request to be traded to Heat:

“As a team, you always hope that you have more options. To have limited options like that, I wouldn’t call it frustrating but it prevents you from perhaps getting the best return.”

Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Matisse Thybulle on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Matisse Thybulle on his situation given he and Damian Lillard share an agent:

“My agent made it clear to me that Dame in Portland and Matisse in Portland are two very separate situations. I took his word for it and didn't give it much more thought.”

Matisse Thybulle on Damian Lillard, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Aaron Goodwin on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Just spoke with Damian Lillard’s agent, Aaron Goodwin:

“Ihad a positive conversation with Joe (Cronin) and I made it clear that Damian would want them to sit down and have a meaningful negotiation with Miami. And I think that’s something that Joe and the Blazers will do.”

Aaron Goodwin on Damian Lillard, Jul 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @AaronJFentress.

item.title: Marc Spears on Damian Lillard, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Additionally, Marc Spears of Andscape hinted during an appearance on NBA Today over the weekend (h/t MassLive's Brian Robb) that Jayson Tatum was trying to get Lillard to consider joining the Celtics.

“I'm hearing Jayson Tatum is knocking on that door now too to figure out a way to get (Lillard) to come to Boston,”

Marc Spears on Damian Lillard, Jayson Tatum, Jul 6, 2023. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Kevin Durant on LeBron James, Damian Lillard, Draymond Green
item.description:
While some view that as being overly sensitive, Durant believes he's being honest and controlling his own narrative, even though it has led to him being singled out.

“I don't see this talked about — I see Damian Lillard, I see LeBron [James], I see Draymond [Green], I see lots of great players in our league speak up on social media, but they don't get that 'sensitive' rep,”

Kevin Durant on LeBron James, Damian Lillard, Draymond Green, Apr 13, 2023. Source: FoxSports.com.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Matt Barnes:

“I hope we don't see Damian Lillard in a Portland Trail Blazers uniform no more. That's no knock on him. I just you know as loyal his as he and you and... I think the only way Dame leaves Portland is if they quote unquote make him leave (...) I think Portland's gonna have to push him out to get him to leave. I don't think if you leave it up to him that he's going to leave at this point.”

Matt Barnes on Damian Lillard, Mar 30, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Matisse Thybulle on Damian Lillard
item.description:
“Joel was an amazing example of that, and now I've got guys like Damian Lillard, who also have my back,and it's it's really nice to see how all that transition has gone. Now being on a new team, I know how important it is to have the belief of your best player and how far that goes. Like how Joel’s been doing it in Philly for years and now how Dame is doing it for me, it really is a big deal and a sign of leadership.”

Matisse Thybulle on Damian Lillard, Mar 11, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Joe Cronin:

“This [deadline] was unique. The goal when I started this job was to put a championship roster around Damian Lillard. The goal going into this deadline was to be extremely aggressive. We had identified several players who were difference-makers.”

Joe Cronin on Damian Lillard, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Damian Lillard
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups on reducing Damian Lillard's workload:

“We have good depth in the backcourt. If Dame is playing anywhere from 32-34 minutes, that's great. He wants to play 42 minutes. If we have it where we want it, I'm hoping around 34. But we'll see.”

Chauncey Billups on Damian Lillard, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.
